parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry-point aliases in structurally unrelated packages: WXUI, Wallpaper, PlayerHeaderView, app:WatchXYC, and app:WXYC TV. Each alias carries a distinct, domain-specific name (WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, WXYCTVApp) and lives in its own package's entry-point file. The structural similarity is purely coincidental — every SwiftUI app target must declare exactly one @main type, so the zero-field shape is mandated by the framework, not by shared logic. Extracting or unifying these would break each target's independent entry-point requirement.
